is_anopheles.evidence: The study investigates Anopheles arabiensis collected in Tanzania (page 3: 'Molecular species identification performed on a subset of these confirmed that all samples in Muleba (196 out of 196) and nearly all in Moshi (382 out of 384) were An. arabiensis').

reports_target_markers.evidence: Reports genotyping of target markers including Vgsc L995F (Vgsc-995F), Ace-1 G280S (Ace1-280S), Rdl A296S (Rdl-296S), and Cyp4j5 L43F (Cyp4j5-43F) on page 7.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Page 7 reports exact allele counts/frequencies: 'The only recognised resistance SNP present in Vgsc (target site of deltamethrin) was Vgsc-995F (2 out of 564 haplotypes in Moshi, 0 out of 324 haplotypes in Muleba).' It also notes on page 11 that 'only 2 samples in Moshi carrying the Vgsc-995F mutation', Ace1-280S was completely absent, Rdl-296S was found in 2% of haplotypes from Moshi, and Cyp4j5-43F was fixed for the mutant allele.

african_field_population.evidence: Page 12: 'Mosquito larvae were collected from June to August 2018 from 2 locations in Tanzania, Moshi [-3.384, 37.349] and Muleba [-2.092, 31.574]'.

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary study reporting field collections from Tanzania in 2018, dose-response bioassays, and whole-genome sequencing via MalariaGEN Vector Observatory release Ag3.7.

sub_country_location.evidence: Page 12 provides exact locations and coordinates: 'Moshi [-3.384, 37.349] and Muleba [-2.092, 31.574]' (and page 13 specifies Kyamyorwa village in Muleba).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Page 12: 'Mosquito larvae were collected from June to August 2018'.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Page 3: 'Samples for this study were sequenced as part of the MalariaGEN Vector Observatory release Ag3.7 (https://www.malariagen.net/data), which produces SNP and CNV calls, as well as phased haplotype calls.' Samples also belong to the GAARD project.

supplement.evidence: Extractable marker frequencies/haplotype counts (e.g. Vgsc-995F in Moshi and Muleba), sample sizes, and GPS coordinates are reported directly in the main text.

assessment.summary: The authors conducted GWAS and whole-genome sequencing (Ag1000G release 3.7) on Anopheles arabiensis collected in 2018 from Moshi and Muleba, Tanzania, following deltamethrin and pirimiphos-methyl bioassays. They identified metabolic resistance driven by CNVs in carboxylesterases (Coeae2g-Coeae6g) and cytochrome P450s (Cyp6aa/Cyp6p). Target-site mutations were rare: Vgsc L995F was present in only 2 of 564 haplotypes in Moshi and 0 of 324 haplotypes in Muleba, Ace-1 280S was absent, Rdl 296S was found in 2% of haplotypes in Moshi, and Cyp4j5 43F was fixed.
